context.verdict: Approved. The overhaul fully delivers on PARALLAX_OVERHAUL_PLAN across all 5 workstreams with zero regressions. tsc clean; zero pageerrors + zero console errors across the full 11572px page at all six scroll positions. WS1 hero = genuine CSS-sticky Firewatch parallax from the 9 real (downscaled) PNG layers, recolored to the cool blue-hour palette, wordmark masked, identity floating above — blends naturally with the dark site. WS3 Projects is the ONLY GSAP pin (static horizontal track, matchMedia desktop gate + MIN_PIN_TRAVEL guard + mobile stacked fallback) and the mid-scroll shot shows offset slides. WS2 TravelerModel (dev laptop) damps per-section + pauses via portfolio:bg-pause (headless falls back to SVG core, expected). WS4 reveals/tilt/timeline-draw/CTA all render full content. WS5 guardrails intact: native scroll only, rAF owns hero transforms, no React-children+textContent count-up mix, reduced-motion/touch fallbacks throughout.
